Question Choices: Find the least positive modular inverse of phi(13) modulo 17.
Hints: Find x such that 12x leaves remainder 1 when divided by 17.
Solution: phi(13)=12. Back-substitution gives 12*(-7) + 17*(5) = 1. Reduce -7 modulo 17 to get 10; 12*10 = 17*7 + 1.

Question Choices: Find the least positive inverse of (phi(10))! modulo 13.
Hints: Evaluate the totient, reduce its factorial modulo the modulus, then invert that residue.
Solution: phi(10)=4. Its factorial is congruent to 11 modulo 13; 11*6 ≡ 1 (mod 13). The inverse is 6.
